title: ChatCPU: An Agile CPU Design and Verification Platform with LLM
problem: Existing LLMs exhibit challenges in HDL design and verification for complex hardware systems. The increasing complexity of semiconductor designs requires agile development methodologies.
motivation: LLMs offer new opportunities for hardware design automation, but their application to complex ASIC design and verification remains challenging.
method: ChatCPU trains a language model on CPU design knowledge, then uses it to automatically generate RTL code (the detailed hardware blueprint) directly from written specifications. The system applies specialized hardware-design techniques to guide the design through manufacturing and verification steps, which speeds up iteration cycles and shortens total development time.
key_novelty: The system used a language model to automate the entire CPU design workflow from specifications to taping out (manufacturing), successfully producing a production-ready 6-stage RISC-V CPU.
contributions: ChatCPU end-to-end platform enabling LLM-driven hardware design from specifications to RTL
LLM fine-tuning methodology achieving 2.63X design capability improvement over base LLaMA2
Processor description language for automated CPU design
6-stage RISC-V CPU successfully taped out on SkyWater 130nm, the largest LLM-generated CPU design

metrics.speedup: 3.81X average design efficiency, 12X in HDL implementations, 9.33X in verification
metrics.other: 2.63X LLM design capability enhancement over base LLaMA2
